status: post hoc, exploratory, label-free check scored against evidence labels; no model call, no network, no server access

matcher.rule: whitespace runs collapse to one space and ends are stripped; case sensitive; plain substring test against the whitespace-normalised view the judge received; a list needs every non-empty string element to match; empty or non-string spans fail
matcher.credit: J >= 2; withdrawal J* = J if J < 2 or span verbatim else min(J, 1)

sensitivities.full_withdrawal: J* = 0 on a failing credit (A->B only)
sensitivities.elision_tolerant: split at '...'/ellipsis, fragments >= 12 chars all verbatim, or strict pass
